g.text: Servlet MDC may mirror requestId while the request thread is active.
It is cleared in finally and never used as async source of truth.
No caller headers, credentials, prompt text,
tool arguments, thinking, or response model.
Atomic terminal state prevents duplicate logs from
onCompletion, onTimeout, onError, and write failure races.
enrich after session lookup and user-entry commit
exactly one HTTP or SSE completion log
